content: {"reasoning":"The claim has already been submitted both with records and clean, but the payer has returned no adjudication or information request; another submission risks unnecessary duplication and has not succeeded on similar claims. Billing the patient or writing off is premature before payer adjudication, while authorization, appeal, peer-to-peer, and correction paths are inapplicable, so a specialist must investigate claim receipt/status within the filing window.","action":"escalate"}
